d:
History's greatest mysteries often lie buried beneath the surface. From a mass grave of Roman gladiators and mysterious red skulls to a temple believed to be a gateway to the underworld, each discovery holds clues to a forgotten past. With advanced forensic technology, experts uncover the secrets hidden within these ancient sites and remains.
Watch Ancient Unexplained Files, S1, Episodes 6, 1, 3, 9, 10, 2 & 4 on Discovery Channel India.
